+        counts = {}

+        if any(not low <= counts.get(name, 0) <= high

+        value = sum(job["value"] for job in group)

+def _schedule(data):
+    jobs = [job for job in data["jobs"]
+            if job["id"] not in data.get("blocked", [])]
+    k = data["k"]
+    mandatory = set(data.get("mandatory", []))
+    if not mandatory.issubset({job["id"] for job in jobs}) or len(mandatory) > k:
+        return {"error": "impossible"}
+
+    quotas = data.get("quotas", {})
+    best_value = None
+    best_ids = None
+    for group in combinations(jobs, k):
+        ids = [job["id"] for job in group]
+        if not mandatory.issubset(ids):
+            continue
+        counts = {}
+        for job in group:
+            counts[job["group"]] = counts.get(job["group"], 0) + 1
+        if any(not low <= counts.get(name, 0) <= high
+               for name, (low, high) in quotas.items()):
+            continue
+        intervals = sorted((job["start"], job["end"]) for job in group)
+        if any(intervals[i][0] < intervals[i - 1][1]
+               for i in range(1, len(intervals))):
+            continue
+        value = sum(job["value"] for job in group)
+        sorted_ids = sorted(ids)
+        if (best_value is None or value > best_value
+                or (value == best_value and sorted_ids < best_ids)):
+            best_value, best_ids = value, sorted_ids
+    if best_value is None:
+        return {"error": "impossible"}
+    return {"selected": best_ids, "value": best_value}
